newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso extends loss vs dlr, ends at new low.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso extends loss vs dlr, ends at new low.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended sharply lower against the dollar at 1,105.00 after taking a beating from unexpectedly high demand for U.S. currency on the interbank market, dealers said.
It was the first time ever that the peso closed below 1,100 and the local currency fell 8.3 pesos on the day, its steepest decline in recent memory.

Dealers had expected the peso to recover slightly after dropping 2.25 pesos versus the dollar in Tuesday's trade. But they said demand for dollars from the energy sector and airlines far outweighed supply.
"Passing through the 1,100 barrier had a pyschological effect," one dealer said in a telephone interview, adding that it had caused many market players to immediately extend their dollar positions.

Dealers, who ruled out any intervention by the central bank in Wednesday's volatile session, reported an above-average 441 trades for a total of $223 million and said the peso ranged between 1,096.50 and a historic low of 1,106.00.
